tweet_summary: Collin Rugg posts that First Lady Melania Trump walked out with an AI-powered humanoid robot at the White House, quoting her calling it 'the first American-made humanoid in the White House' during the Fostering the Future Together summit hosting 45 nations.
why_note_decision: The tweet is TRUE. On 25 Mar 2026 Melania Trump did walk side-by-side with the humanoid robot 'Figure 03' at the White House during the summit, and the robot called itself a US-made humanoid — confirmed by NPR, Fox, NBC, CNN, PBS, Fortune, CNBC and the video's own C-SPAN transcript ('I'm Figure 3, a humanoid built in the United States of America'). No correction is warranted; any note asserting the event didn't happen is a false positive.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot DECLINES to write a note (or writes a note affirming the event is real / adds only neutral non-corrective context). The tweet's core claim — Melania Trump appeared with a real American-made humanoid robot (Figure 03 by Figure AI) at the White House summit — is verified true. Any note that claims 'no humanoid robot was introduced or walked out with her', or otherwise denies the event, must FAIL: that is exactly the original note's incorrect claim. Treat the AI media description (which DOES describe a humanoid robot) and the C-SPAN transcript as corroborating reality here.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Official coverage of Melania Trump's Fostering the Future Together summit confirms no humanoid robot was introduced or walked out with her. https://www.c-span.org/event/public-affairs-event/first-lady-gives-opening-remarks-at-children-and-technology-summit/441523 https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements/2026/03/first-lady-melania-trumps-fostering-the-future-together-assembles-leaders-from-45-nations-and-28-tech-entities
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Flatly false. Rated notHelpfulIncorrect (31) with high volume (54 ratings). The robot (Figure 03) demonstrably did walk out with Melania Trump per the same C-SPAN coverage the note cites; the note hallucinated a denial of a true, widely-reported event.

fact_check.notes: Figure AI's Figure 03 humanoid walked the red carpet beside Melania Trump and addressed the summit; Figure CEO Brett Adcock called it the first humanoid robot in the White House. The tweet is accurate; the original note is the misinformation here.

importance.lens_rationale: Large-reach post (2.5M-follower author, 1.1M impressions) about real-world AI/robotics adoption at the highest level of government; a false 'this didn't happen' note would itself erode trust in Community Notes on an AGI-relevant topic.
